mainline_bootstrap.basis: Default value of the documented libtorrent setting dht_bootstrap_nodes; the operator runs it for exactly this purpose and describes it in the libtorrent blog post 'DHT bootstrap node' (2016-09).
Router node named in BEP 5 and listed as a bootstrap node in the libtorrent settings reference; a long-standing public entry point of the Mainline DHT.

ygg_peers.basis: Listed by its operator in the official yggdrasil-network/public-peers repository (north-america/united-states.md); that list exists so that anyone may peer with the listed nodes. The list publishes no further terms and no uptime guarantee.
